sourceInputs.path: dist/Jentra OS Isolated Windows Setup 20261013 r5 a2.cmd

requirementRows.fullStatement: FR-530: Native Analytics, AI, integration, subscription, and authorized operator workspaces MUST offer scoped filters, source explanations, keyboard access, and distinct empty, denied, conflict, stale, and unavailable states.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Complete genuine Connected Analytics/AI/integration/subscription/operator workflows with scoped basis, keyboard and all named empty/denied/conflict/stale/unavailable states.

requirementRows.fullStatement: FR-531: Saved filters, scenario drafts, and uncertain command envelopes MUST use the existing encrypted actor/context-bound recovery store; sign-out or access loss MUST lock them, and offline recovery MUST not authorize execution.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Run actual encrypted actor/context filter/scenario/uncertain-command recovery after restart, sign-out, permission loss and offline operation without unauthorized execution.

requirementRows.fullStatement: NFR-508: Native views MUST support light/dark, both densities, keyboard focus, and 200% text at 1024x720, 1440x900, and 1920x1080 without inaccessible actions.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Inspect genuine Connected native controls at all three sizes, both themes/densities and 200% text with keyboard reachability; no native actions were observed.

requirementRows.fullStatement: AC-515: Native recovery and usability (FR-530, FR-531, NFR-508) Given pending filters/scenario/command drafts and native theme/density/text variants When the app restarts, changes context, loses access, or disconnects Then encrypted recovery and reachable actions preserve scope without executing an offline mutation.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Complete actual Connected restart/context/access-loss/offline and encrypted recovery in every native variant; fixtures and an absent profile do not establish this.

requirementRows.fullStatement: EC-513: Secure store failure, sign-out, context switch, stale response or disk-full preserves recoverable ciphertext without stale protected display; verify with AC-515.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Run actual isolated secure-store/disk-full/sign-out/context/stale-response recovery. No reversible failure harness or genuine ciphertext/native evidence is installed.

requirementRows.fullStatement: FR-558: The native workspace MUST show scope/window/both cutoffs, definition version, population/completeness, exact duration summaries, and explained unavailable values; stale or denied requests MUST clear prior server evidence.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Inspect actual Connected rendered basis/counts/cutoffs/explanations and stale/denied clearing; source and older preview evidence cannot replace native actions.

requirementRows.fullStatement: FR-559: Saved filters and pending reads MUST preserve context and reject late responses after context changes; saved results MUST not authorize a later read, and only the existing encrypted store MAY persist filter state.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Verify real encrypted saved filter/pending-read context, late response rejection and current authorization after actor/context changes.

requirementRows.fullStatement: AC-556: Native basis and access change (FR-558, FR-559, NFR-554) Given a rendered result and an in-flight read in each supported native variant When context or permissions change, or an older request completes Then prior evidence is cleared, stale output is ignored, and all basis/actions remain reachable.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Complete actual Connected in-flight/context/permission changes across native variants, proving stale output rejection and reachable cleared actions.

requirementRows.fullStatement: EC-558: Provider absence/version drift, network loss, sign-out, context changes and late responses produce explained cleared states; covered by AC-556/558.
requirementRows.nextEvidence: Domain verifier errors are safe; actual provider drift/network/sign-out/context/stale-response cleared native states remain incomplete.

boundary: Validation checks package/source integrity only. It does not establish native keyboard, login, MFA, recovery, context change, revocation, or Windows failure behavior.
